julie_billing: Heads-up — Merchant ACME (ticket #9876) is seeing a spike of card declines this morning. They say customers are using corporate billing with PO Box addresses + VAT numbers. Decline rows show AVS=N / CVV=M and message 'Address mismatch'. Can payments team triage? https://support.redwood.example/t/9876
payments-bot: [webhook] payment.failed delivered for txn=txn_01G7a2b3 (status: declined)
alex_support: adding two sample txns: txn_01G7a2b3, txn_01G7a2b4. Repro curl (redacted card):
```
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/charges \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer sk_live_xxx" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"amount":1000,"currency":"usd","card":{"number":"<redacted>","exp_month":05,"exp_year":2027,"cvc":"123"},"billing":{"line1":"PO Box 812","city":"Dover","postal_code":"19901","country":"US"}}'
```
eric_payments: grabbing gateway logs now. can you paste the raw gateway response for txn_01G7a2b3? need avs/cvv/gateway_code/3ds flags
alex_support: pasted snippet from logs:
```
{\n  "txn_id": "txn_01G7a2b3",\n  "status": "declined",\n  "gateway": "acquirer-bridge-uk",\n  "response": {\n    "avs_code": "N",\n    "cvv_code": "M",\n    "message": "Address mismatch",\n    "acquirer_code": "05",\n    "three_ds": false\n  }\n}
```
eric_payments: thanks. two quick observations: 1) acquirer-bridge-uk treats PO BOXs as non-match for AVS for some corporate issuers, 2) 3DS wasn't attempted — our gateway will skip 3DS if merchant config disables it for low-risk or if card type/country combination doesn't trigger. With 3DS off, we can't fall back to cardholder verification which would likely approve these.
julie_billing: merchant confirms they turned off 3DS for faster checkout (PLG flow). They need a path that doesn't increase friction too much — suggestions?
eric_payments: options (ranked):
- Enable 3DS for the affected merchant/route (targeted): forces a CH verification and should reduce AVS-related declines.
- Ask acquirer to relax AVS rules for the merchant account (acquirer change request) — takes time but avoids UX change.
- Normalize billing before sending: strip or convert PO BOX into a canonical form and send additional metadata (vat_number) so acquirer can apply business rules. Note: removing PO BOX entirely often isn't acceptable for customer data.
- As last resort, allow a manual override path for known good customers (requires fraud ops approval).
alex_support: merchant asked for immediate mitigation that doesn't require acquirer changes. They can toggle 3DS quickly. I'll provision a canary change to enable 3DS for 2% of traffic and monitor.
eric_payments: good. also request BIN/IIN + example PAN BIN ranges and card country for the declined txns so we can open a support case with acquirer and ask how they classify PO BOX.
julie_billing: BINs: 411111, 542000; country: GB, IE. I've added them to ticket #9876.
eric_payments: created internal follow-up: file with acquirer id acq-uk-02, case #ACQ-4321. Recommend merchant enable 3DS canary now and ramp if approved by growth. I'll monitor decline rate and AVS codes.
alex_support: deployed 3DS canary for checkout route at 09:18 UTC. reporting back in 30m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
julie_billing: thanks — keeping customer updated. :thumbsup:
